description: Cross-implementation vectors for the optional PGP payload encryption (contract §2.1). When it is enabled in the Sumsub dashboard, every request body is an ASCII-armored OpenPGP message: the JSON request encrypted to the gateway public key (AES-256), signed inline with the Sumsub key (SHA-256) and ZIP-compressed, the shape PGPainless produces. The gateway must decrypt `signed-encrypted` to `plaintext` and accept it when the current time is `signedAt`, and must reject it once the signature is older than its tolerance. It must reject `unsigned`, `unknown-signer`, `spoofed-key-id` (signed by another key that claims the Sumsub key ID) and `oversized-plaintext` (a forged signature over a plaintext that decompresses beyond 1 MiB) with 422 crypto_failed. X-Payload-Digest is computed over the timestamp, a dot and the armored body exactly as sent. The keys below are throwaway RSA-3072 test keys generated for this file.
